items.defectStatement: Every dynamic import in the appStore object executes when packages/app-store/index.ts is evaluated, initiating loading of all registered integrations even when a caller needs only one. Making the entries promises does not defer loading until an integration is requested.
obligations: Do not initiate integration imports merely by evaluating the registry module.
Accessing an integration must load its corresponding module without initiating imports for unrelated registry entries.
Preserve all registered keys, module paths, and compatibility with existing await appStore[key] consumers.
items.notes: Lazy getters allow a local fix while preserving the promise-valued access contract. Replacing values with ordinary thunks alone breaks existing consumers; that approach also requires edits outside the anchor. Dynamic imports retain module caching.

items.defectStatement: The reschedule handler discards the promises returned by its async forEach callbacks, so calendar and video deletions are not awaited before emails, webhooks, or request completion. Rejections from calendar loading or deletion escape the handler's promise chain and can become unhandled.
obligations: Await calendar loading and applicable calendar/video deletions before proceeding to reschedule notifications on success.
Propagate cancellation failures through the enclosing async handler instead of leaving unobserved rejections.
Preserve UID checks, integration-type dispatch, optional calendar handling, and deletion arguments.
items.notes: There is no surrounding try/catch in this mutation; failures should propagate to its caller. An awaited sequential loop is also valid. Promise.all observes every rejection but can reject before other deletions finish.
